name: Factory — Basic B — Start Approved Task

parameters.content:
CONFIGURE IN N8N UI:
Query GitHub first: if no Building issue exists, select one Approved issue, replace its state label with Building, then POST {issue_number,title,specification} to {{$env.FACTORY_RUNNER_URL}}/runs. Store returned run_id in a GitHub comment, e.g. `Factory run: <id>`.
